Claude Code just shipped something wild.

2 separate coding sessions can now message each other directly.

before this, every session ran in isolation. you'd finish a change in 1 window, then re-explain the whole thing in another.

now you just tell Claude to send it over. it https://t.co/vnHkbH3UdS

getting 2 sessions to talk to each other only matters if each one is running a prompt worth passing along. the coordination is half of it. the prompt driving each session is the other half.

here's how to get every Claude session shipping work you can actually use:

the rest of the library is at https://t.co/QbTXyXRlOk

follow if you're running Claude across a bunch of sessions and want each one to ship sharp, not generic.
